Question: What is the loss ratio of each policy and agent who sold it by policy number and agent id?
What is the loss ratio of each policy and agent who sold it by policy number and agent id?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_ID,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS decimal(18,2)) /
    NULLIF(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN prm.Policy_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(pa.Policy_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS decimal(18,2)), 0) AS Loss_Ratio
FROM Policy p
JOIN Agreement_Party_Role apr
    ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Party_Role pr
    ON pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
LEFT JOIN Policy_Amount pa
    ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Premium prm
    ON prm.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
   AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim c
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Amount ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
WHERE pr.Party_Role_Code = 'AGENT'
GROUP BY
    p.Policy_Number,
    apr.Party_Identifier;

Question: What are the total loss, which is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by claim number and corresponding policy number, policy holder and premium amount paid?

    COALESCE(prm.total_premium_paid, 0) AS premium_amount_paid,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS loss_payment,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS loss_reserve,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expense_payment,

    COALESCE(SUM(CASE
        WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
          OR lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
          OR ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
          OR er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
        THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_loss

LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp

   AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier

    JOIN Premium pr
        ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
) prm
    ON prm.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
